reasons: Genuine version reviewed on its merits. All 26 cited spans and text hashes match the held bytes. Identity: EO 9155, 7 FR 3277, 'Approving Regulations of the Civil Service Commission Relating to Efficiency-Rating Boards of Review', signed May 1, 1942 (Franklin D Roosevelt; Commissioners Mitchell, McMillin, Fleming). The eleven clauses (items 1, 2, 3(a)-(e), 4, 5, 6, 7) cover every operative item in contiguous spans; the approving sentence is the vehicle for the regulations and shares their lifecycle. Items 1-6 end 1942-10-09: EO 9252 (7 FR 8079, signed 'October 9, 1942') item 8 provides that its regulations 'supersede the regulations ... in Executive Order No. 9155 of May 1, 1942' and are 'effective immediately'. Its retroactive exception reaches only EO 9252's own Section 3 successor-service provision. Item 7 (effective date July 1, 1942 and supersession of the EO 8748 regulations) was performed on 1942-07-01, and the claim records the EO 9252 supersession as a later event for it. whole_order_end 1942-10-09 equals the latest clause end. The only FR disposition note ('Superseded by: EO 9252, October 9, 1942') is addressed. Cruden finds no other held text that ends EO 9155 (the EO 9154 and source-ladder hits are the same FR page, the EO 9253 hit is the shared EO 9252 page, and the APP hit is EO 9252). No savings clause keeps it alive; accrued board decisions are results. Dates, actor, mechanism, quotes and reasons are consistent with each other.
